title: Flow Failure
fullDescription: FLO appears on Master Spas Balboa controllers when the heater pressure switch does not close. Common with dirty filters.

title: Flow Switch Stuck Closed
shortDescription: Pressure switch closed when pump off.
fullDescription: HFL indicates flow switch stuck closed.

title: Spa Overheat Lockout
fullDescription: OH locks heater when water too hot.

title: Hi-Limit Tripped
fullDescription: HL means the heater hi-limit thermistor sensed unsafe temp.

title: Temperature Sensor A Fault
fullDescription: SnSa indicates main temp sensor open or shorted.

title: Priming Mode
fullDescription: Pr indicates priming mode after fill or power cycle.

title: Freeze Protection Active
fullDescription: ICE indicates anti-freeze cycle is running.

title: Topside Communication Lost
fullDescription: COMM indicates topside lost comm with main pack.
